# Young Vision (HK) Limited

> Exclusive Hong Kong distributor of premium tech brands including Brother, Fujitsu, AVer, Targus, Kensington, and specialty accessories for education, conferencing, and office environments.

Young Vision is a major technology distributor in Hong Kong specializing in interactive panels, video conferencing solutions, office equipment, and device protection accessories. The company serves both retail customers and B2B resellers through dedicated wholesale portals.

## Key Topics

- Brother products
- Fujitsu interactive panels
- Video conferencing systems
- AVer auto-tracking cameras
- Smart whiteboards
- 4K UHD displays
- PCAP touch technology
- Targus accessories
- Kensington security
- BlueLounge cable management
- Office supplies
- Label printers
- Interactive displays
- Conference equipment
- Device protection

## Interactive Panels & Smart Whiteboards

- [Fujitsu Interactive Panel Smart Whiteboard](https://www.yv.com.hk/collections/fujitsu-interactive-panel-smart-whiteboard): Fujitsu interactive panels and smart whiteboards for education and meetings
- [Fujitsu Interactive Panel](https://www.yv.com.hk/collections/fujitsu-interactive-panel): Fujitsu interactive touchscreen displays for education and business
